get.summary: Audit log of the caller's organization(s).

post.summary:
Log in with email + password. Sets an `HttpOnly` session cookie.
Repeated failures are throttled (`429` with `Retry-After`).
Log out: revoke the current session and clear the cookie.

get.summary: Whether single sign-on is offered, for the sign-in page.
The identity provider's answer: signs the person in and redirects.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Set by the provider when the person or the provider refused.

303.description: Signed in, or back to the sign-in page

get.summary: Start signing in: redirects to the identity provider.

parameters.name: returnTo
parameters.description: A path on this site to return to after signing in.

get.summary: The organization's CI trust policies.

post.summary:
Trust one GitHub repository's workflows to deploy into a project.
Exchanged tokens act with the creator's authority, capped at `role`.

delete.summary: Revoke a trust policy and every token exchanged under it.

get.summary: GitHub App installations linked to the caller's organization.

post.summary:
Link a GitHub App installation to the caller's organization. GitHub is
asked first; an installation stays with the organization that linked it.

get.summary: Per-subsystem health (authenticated).
The organization's incidents, newest first.

post.summary: Acknowledge an open incident: someone is on it.
Resolve an open incident by hand (a success resolves it on its own).

get.summary: The authenticated user.

post.summary: Replace the caller's password. Every other session is signed out.

get.summary: Members of the caller's organization.

post.summary: Invite a member. New accounts get a one-time temporary password.

delete.summary: Remove a member: bindings, sessions and tokens are revoked immediately.

get.summary: List projects visible to the caller.

post.summary: Create a project; its `Project` resource follows.

get.summary: One project.

delete.summary:
Delete an empty project. Projects with environments are refused (`409`):
deleting environments is an explicit, per-environment decision.

get.summary: Who answers for an application (in every environment).

put.summary: Name who answers for an application.

get.summary: List a project's environments.

post.summary: Create an environment: its namespace follows.

get.summary: One environment.

delete.summary:
Delete an environment. Production environments need the
`env-delete-protected` permission and are purged after a grace period.

get.summary: List the apps of an environment.

post.summary:
Deploy a new app from a container image, or from a Git repository. A tag
is resolved to a digest at its registry; a Git app deploys with its first
build.

503.description: The image's registry cannot be reached

get.summary:
App detail with pods. Plain env values are included only for callers
holding `secret-read`.

delete.summary:
Delete an app and everything it owns. Volumes are kept unless
`delete_volumes=true`.

parameters.name: delete_volumes
parameters.description: Also delete the app's persistent volumes. Irreversible.

patch.summary:
Update an app (image changes require `app-deploy`). Every change is a new
deployment run; a new tag is resolved to a digest at its registry.

503.description: The image's registry cannot be reached

get.summary: The app's newest builds.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Newest first; 20 unless given, at most 100.

get.summary: One build of the app.

post.summary:
Stop a build. A build that has not started is cancelled at once; a
running one is stopped by deleting its Job, and ends `cancelled` once the
Job is gone — or `succeeded` if its output was already pushed and
verifies.

202.description: The stop was asked; poll the build

get.summary: The app's newest deployment runs, each with its timeline.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many runs, newest first (1–50, default 10).

post.summary: Accept a deployment of this app.
post.description:
The release (from `image`, or an existing `release`), the configuration
revision and the run are written in one transaction with the audit record
and the message to the executors; then the call answers `202` with the
run's `Location`. Replaying the request with the same `Idempotency-Key`
returns the first run.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays of the same request return the first run

409.description: A stale expected generation, or an Idempotency-Key used for another request

get.summary: One deployment run of this app.
The approval state of a deployment run.

post.summary:
Approve a deployment waiting for approval. Enough approvals release it to
the cluster at once.

403.description: Not an approver here, an API token, or the requester

409.description: Not waiting, expired, already decided, or a changed plan

post.summary: Reject a deployment waiting for approval; it is cancelled.
Detach an app: Kuben lets go of it and leaves its objects running.

202.description: Detach scheduled; the answer holds the export

409.description: Being deleted, a run in flight, or never delivered

get.summary:
Why the app is or is not reachable: the GatewayClass and the Gateway, the
issuer, ports 80 and 443 (from the server), the route, each host's
certificate and DNS, and the agent that delivers it.
Check that every hostname of the app points at the gateway.

post.summary:
Return an app to an earlier release now, past approvals, a freeze, the
scan gate and a pause. People with approval rights only; the reason is
kept.

get.summary:
The app's Kubernetes events (pods, workloads, route, certificates),
newest first, at most 100. Kubernetes keeps events for about an hour.

Export an app: portable release and configuration, standard manifests,
references, inventory and runbook. No secret values.

post.summary:
Hand an app over from the App controller to its cluster's agent: its
next run goes through the agent, which adopts the app's workloads in
place (no new pods), and every later run follows. Only toward the agent;
the cluster needs a linked agent that carries applications.

409.description: Delivered by the agent already, being deleted, or no agent to take it

get.summary:
Log lines of the app's pods (at most 10 pods): the recent ones, or with
`follow=true` a live stream of new ones.

parameters.name: previous
parameters.description: Logs of the previous (crashed) container instance.

parameters.name: follow
parameters.description:
Keep the connection open and send new lines as `text/event-stream`:
`line` events (a [`LogLine`]) and an `end` event (a [`LogEnd`]) when a
pod's log stops or the stream reaches its hour.

200.description: Recent lines per pod; with `follow`, `text/event-stream` of `line` (LogLine) and `end` (LogEnd) events

post.summary: Hold an app's delivery: new runs are accepted and wait.
Promote the app to another environment of the same project.

get.summary: Release history, newest first (50 revisions).

post.summary: Rolling restart of every process (no spec change).
Resume an app's delivery: its newest waiting run is written.

Roll back to an earlier revision: a new run of its release and
configuration. The app stays on it until automatic deploys resume.
Run a scheduled process now (a Job from its CronJob template).

get.summary:
The CycloneDX SBOM of one image of the app's current release
(gzip-encoded JSON).
The scans of the app's current release and the gate's verdict.
The app's Git source.

404.description: No such app, or it has no Git source

put.summary: Build the app from a Git repository and branch, or change how.
put.description:
A change stops earlier builds from deploying themselves and builds the
branch head again.

post.summary: Read the branch head from GitHub now and build it if it is new.

get.summary: The apps detached from an environment.
One detached app, with its export.

post.summary:
Release a detached app: someone owns it now, and deleting the
environment no longer keeps its namespace.

409.description: Not complete yet, or released already

get.summary: The environment's change freezes in force or to come.

post.summary: Freeze an environment: new releases are refused until it ends.

get.summary: Members with a role on this environment.

put.summary: Give an organization member a role on this environment, or change it.

delete.summary: Remove a member's role on this environment.

get.summary: The environment's protection policy.

put.summary:
Change the environment's protection policy. Stricter policies need
`env-write`; anything weaker needs an owner.

403.description: Weakening needs an owner; tokens cannot change policies

get.summary: List the registry logins of an environment (never their passwords).

put.summary: Set the login of a registry: a new revision, used by the next runs.

409.description: The name or registry is taken

delete.summary: Delete a registry login. Runs accepted with it keep their revision.

409.description: An app reads it as a secret

get.summary: List the secrets of an environment (names and keys).

put.summary:
Set a secret's values: a new revision, rolled out unless `rollout` is
false.

409.description: The environment is being deleted, or the name is a registry login

delete.summary: Delete a secret. Refused while an app of the environment references it.

get.summary: The revisions of an encrypted secret, newest first (no values).

post.summary:
Revoke a revision for good: runs bound to it fail instead of delivering
it. Revoking the current revision blocks deployments until a new value is
set.

get.summary: The environment's alert silences in force.

post.summary: Silence the alerts of an environment, or of one of its apps.
Deploy a template into an environment.

get.summary: Members with a role on this project.

put.summary: Give an organization member a role on this project, or change it.

403.description: Above your own role, or an API token

404.description: Not a member of the organization

delete.summary: Remove a member's role on this project; their organization role stays.

get.summary: Who answers for a project.

put.summary: Name who answers for a project.

get.summary: Whether the first admin account still has to be created.

post.summary: Create the organization and its first admin (owner), and sign in.

403.description: Missing, wrong or expired setup token, or plain HTTP from another machine (`insecure_transport`)

get.summary: The template catalogue.
The caller's API tokens.

post.summary: Create a personal API token.

delete.summary: Revoke one of the caller's tokens (immediately effective).

get.summary: The organization's vulnerability exceptions in force (or all).

post.summary: Let one finding pass the scan gates for a while.

get.summary: The organization's webhook endpoints.

post.summary: Add a webhook endpoint; the answer holds its signing secret, once.

delete.summary: Disable a webhook endpoint for good.

get.summary: The newest deliveries to an endpoint.

post.summary: Send a `ping` event to an endpoint.

env.description: Values are only included in the app detail, for callers allowed to read secrets.

oneOf.description:
Whether the app can be reached through the gateway, apart from
whether it runs (null while it has no route).

paused.description: Why delivery is paused, while it is: new runs wait.

AppEvent.description: A Kubernetes event about one of the app's objects.

kind.description:
Kind and name of the object (`Pod`, `Deployment`, `HTTPRoute`,
`Certificate`, …).

gate.description: `pass`, `warn` or `block`: what the environment's gate says now.

requestedBy.description: Email of whoever asked for the deployment.

required.description: Distinct approvals needed; 0 when the run needs none.

expiresAt.description: When the run is cancelled unless approved (Unix milliseconds).

planHash.description: What an approver confirms: send it back with the decision.

canDecide.description: Whether the caller may decide on this run now.

actor.description: Email of the actor (or its id if the user no longer exists).

next_before.description: Pass as `before` to fetch the next (older) page.

attempt.description: 1 for the first attempt; an infrastructure retry is the next one.

deployDecision.description:
`deployed`, or why the build did not deploy (`StaleSource`,
`BuildConfigChanged`, `NotAutomatic`, …).

image.description: The image to run; give this or `git`.

oneOf.description:
Build the app from a Git repository instead (M3); its first build
deploys it.

port.description: Port the process listens on; omit for workers and scheduled jobs.

max_replicas.description: CPU autoscaling up to this many replicas when greater than `replicas`.

schedule.description: Cron expression: the app runs as a scheduled job (no port).

fs_group.description: Group id owning the volumes, for images running as a non-root user.

environment.description: Narrows the tokens to one environment of `project`.

environments.description: GitHub environments allowed; empty for any.

events.description:
Workflow events allowed; `push`, `workflow_dispatch` and `release`
when empty.

tokenTtlSecs.description: Life of an exchanged token, 60–3600 seconds (default 900).

name.description: Short name, e.g. `prod` (the object is named `<project>-<name>`).

owner.description: Who answers for it: a person or a team.

project.description: Limit it to one project; every project when omitted.

role.description: Upper bound on what the token may do: `viewer`, `developer` or `admin`.

project.description: Restrict the token to one project.

environment.description: Restrict the token to one environment of `project`.

app.description: Silences only: one app of the environment.

token.description: The token itself. Shown exactly once; only its hash is stored.

planHash.description: The plan hash shown with the deployment (hex).

comment.description: Why, for the record; at most 1024 characters.

name.description: App name (also the in-cluster hostname of TCP services).

credentials_secret.description: Secret with the generated credentials, e.g. `db-credentials`.

connection_keys.description: Reference it from other apps as `KEY=@<secret>/<key>`.

DeploymentDto.description: A deployment run and where it stands.

generation.description: The target generation this run owns.

approvals_required.description: Distinct approvals the environment's policy requires before delivery.

approval_expires_at.description: When a run waiting for approval is cancelled (Unix milliseconds).

plan_hash.description: The hash approvers confirm (hex), when approvals are required.

warnings.description: What admission could not check, e.g. that the pods will be scheduled.

DeploymentSummary.description: A deployment run with how it went.

generation.description: The target generation (the app's revision) this run owns.

requested_by.description: Email of whoever asked for it.

timeline.description: Every phase it entered, oldest first.

reason.description: Why; kept with the record and audited.

completedAt.description: Set once the objects are orphaned.

export.description: The export frozen with the request (only when one app is read).

subject.description: What was checked (a host, a class, a port), when there are several.

status.description: The worst status of the checks; `unknown` is never `ok`.

addresses.description: Addresses the host currently resolves to.

reason.description: Why this cannot wait; kept on the run and in the audit log.

release.description:
The release to return to; the newest earlier release that ran
successfully when omitted.

failures.description: Deliveries given up in a row; the endpoint is disabled at 20.

secret.description: The signing secret: shown once, when the endpoint is made.

EnvVarDto.description: Environment variable: a plain `value` or a `secret` reference.

name.description: Short name used in URLs, e.g. `prod`.

deletion_scheduled_at.description: When a soft-deleted environment will be purged.

ExposureDto.description: How an app is reached through the gateway.

routed.description:
The gateway accepted the route and resolved its references; null
until a gateway controller answered.

tls.description:
`auto` (certificate from the cluster issuer), `secret` (the app's own
certificate) or `none` (plain HTTP).

certificate_ready.description: For `auto` hosts with a certificate of their own: whether it is issued.

oneOf.description: The newest scan; `None` when the image was never scanned.

account.description: The GitHub user or organization the App is installed on.

temporary_password.description:
Temporary password for a newly created account. Shown once; it must be
replaced at the first login. `null` when the user already existed.

installationId.description: The id GitHub shows after the App is installed.

LogEnd.description:
A followed log stopped: one pod's (its container ended or could not be
read; a restarted container is followed again), or all of them (`pod` is
absent: the stream reached its limit).

LogLine.description: One line of a followed log.

must_change_password.description: Invited and has not replaced the temporary password yet.

contact.description: How to reach them: an email, a chat channel, an on-call rotation.

PhaseStep.description: One step of a run's timeline.

at.description: When the run entered it, Unix milliseconds.

error.description: Why no logs could be read (e.g. the container is still starting).

revision.description: 0 when the environment has no policy of its own yet.

to_environment.description: Target environment (short name) in the same project.

created.description: The app did not exist in the target and was (or would be) created.

changes.description: Human-readable diff; values of environment variables are never shown.

warnings.description: E.g. secrets referenced by the app that are missing in the target.

deployRole.description: The weakest role that may deploy: `developer`, `admin` or `owner`.

approveRole.description: The weakest role that may approve: `admin` or `owner`.

approvalTtlSecs.description: How long a deployment waits for approvals (300 s – 30 days).

oneOf.description: The vulnerability gate; the current one is kept when omitted.

password.description: A password or access token; write-only.

data.description: Key → UTF-8 value. Replaces the whole secret with a new revision.

rollout.description: Roll the new value out to the apps that reference the secret.

installationId.description: A GitHub App installation linked to this organization.

context.description: Build context inside the repository; the root when empty.

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile relative to the context; `Dockerfile` when unset.

imageRepository.description: Where builds push, without tag or digest.

registry.description: The registry as image references name it (`ghcr.io`, `docker.io`).

revoked.description:
The current revision is revoked: images from the registry are not
deployed until a new login is set.

actor.description: Email of whoever made the change.

current.description: The newest revision (what should be running).

RolloutDto.description: One app's rollout of a new secret value.

run.description: The rotation run; `None` when the app could not take one now.

process.description: Scheduled process to run (default: the first one).

status.description:
`ok`, or `unavailable` when the scanner, its feed or the image was
not reachable (never "clean").

databaseUpdatedAt.description: When the vulnerability database was built.

ScanGateDto.description: What vulnerability findings a deployment may carry.

severity.description: Findings at or above this severity count: `high` or `critical`.

requireScan.description: An image without a fresh successful scan counts as a finding.

maxAgeSecs.description: A scan older than this no longer counts (1 hour – 90 days).

keys.description: Key names only; values are never returned.

revision.description: The current revision of an encrypted secret.

revoked.description: The current revision is revoked: set a new value before deploying.

rollouts.description: The runs that roll a new value out, after a change.

SecretStorage.description: Where a secret's values are kept.

token.description: The setup token from the installer's link, when required.

needed.description: No admin account exists yet; the console shows `/setup`.

token_required.description: `POST /setup` must carry the token the installer printed.

secure.description:
The admin may be created over this connection (HTTPS, this machine,
or allowed by configuration); otherwise `POST /setup` answers 403.

head.description: The last head read from GitHub.

syncOperation.description: The sync this change or request queued, if any.

image.description:
Image by digest: `registry/repository@sha256:…`. Give either `image`
or `release`.

release.description: An existing release of this app: a rollback or a redeploy.

config.description:
The app configuration: the app spec without its image. Omitted, the
app's latest configuration is used.

expected_generation.description:
The target generation the caller last saw. A deploy never silently
replaces a newer one: a stale value is refused with `409`.

prefix.description: Non-secret prefix to recognise the token, e.g. `kbn_pat_0192f3a1`.

UpdateApp.description: Partial update; omitted fields are left unchanged, lists are replaced.

health_check_path.description: Empty string removes the health check.

volumes.description: Replaces the list. Removed volumes are unmounted, never deleted.

via.description: How the request was authenticated: `session` or `token`.

must_change_password.description:
The temporary password must be replaced (`POST /me/password`) before
anything else is allowed.

VolumeDto.description: Persistent volume (kept when the app is deleted, unless requested).

size.description: Capacity such as `5Gi`. Can grow, never shrink.

app.description: Silences only: the app, when not the whole environment.
